instruction.description: Logical left shift each unsigned 16-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 16, store the result in `dst`.

throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 1.99 cycles. The measured CPI 0.2487 is the nominal 0.25 within measurement noise; the value is reported as the nominal figure.

notes: LASX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000). Both vector sources are recorded separately; they share the same result path where the hardware is symmetric. Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
